int[][] matrix := array(5, fill = array(6, fill = 0))
dr := [0, 1, 0, -1]
dc := [1, 0, -1, 0]
row := 0
column := 0
direction := 0
for: 1 <= value <= 30
    matrix[row][column] = value
    if value == 30
        break
    next_row := row + dr[direction]
    next_column := column + dc[direction]
    if not (0 <= next_row < 5 and 0 <= next_column < 6) or matrix[next_row][next_column] != 0
        direction = (direction + 1) % 4
        next_row = row + dr[direction]
        next_column = column + dc[direction]
    row = next_row
    column = next_column
for values := matrix[]
    for value := values[]
        print("{value:3.}")
    println()
